dedupe_keys.name: d4 3 recommendations on eaop cw based treatment system for water reuse applications

description: Meijide Fernández, Jessica and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented Montornes del Valles treatment demonstration combines electrochemical advanced oxidation with constructed wetlands for reclaimed-water irrigation. Approximately sixty percent of influent at the named wastewater plant is industrial. The source describes an electrochemical oxidation/ozonation stage followed by wetland treatment using named plant species. Related biofilm and upgrade-guidance material is grouped as context. The abstract does not supply a complete numerical removal or energy balance, and regulatory-compliance assertions are not independently verified. This case supports assessment of the tested treatment configuration and its water-reuse purpose within the reported setting. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
